title: Search GSTIN Details response
description: NIC taxpayer payload returned at data.Data for a successful Sandbox response.

AddrPncd.description: PIN code of the registered address.

BlkStatus.description: Status indicating whether invoice or E-Way Bill generation is blocked for the GSTIN.

DtDReg.description: GST registration cancellation date, if applicable.

Gstin.description: GSTIN for which taxpayer details were requested.

LegalName.description: Legal name registered against the GSTIN.

StateCode.description: GST state code associated with the registered address.

Status.description: GST registration status, such as ACT for active.

TradeName.description: Trade name registered against the GSTIN, if available.
